description: This file declares the SiftStore class, which manages event storage with functions to get, remove, and post events. It also includes dependencies and namespace organization, indicating its role in backend event handling within the WPEFramework Plugin module.

classes.name: SiftStore
classes.description: A class that encapsulates event storage logic, managing event counts, retrieval, removal, and posting events with thread safety.

methods.name: SiftStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SiftStore with a specified path and event limit.

methods.name: GetEventCount
methods.description: Returns the count of current events as a pair of uint32_t values.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event strings starting from a specified index.

methods.name: RemoveEvents
methods.description: Removes events within a specified range.
